# Gazette house style

## Structure

1. New editions go directly below the masthead (the italic line under the title), newest first.
2. Heading: `## Edition N — Day D of the Founding`, where N is one more than the newest edition.
3. One `###` headline in ALL CAPS, at most 12 words, followed by 2 to 4 sentences.
4. Optionally one more `###` item for smaller news.
5. End every edition with `> **Goose Watch:** <the goose's current mood in one line>.`

## Voice

- Breathless, local, and proud. Puns are encouraged; one per edition is plenty.
- Exaggerate the tone, never the facts: every name, number, and verdict must match the council minutes, permit register, and ledger.
- Quote officials by office ("the Treasurer said"), never by invented personal names.
- If the inspector denied something, report it with dignity. The city respects its own laws.
